ref: ADR-0006 Consequences, createIf (amended with #133, F-37): false and 0 give SUPPRESS, observed in #31; assumed until obs-target-creation-2 (#134) answers: a SUPPRESS slot gives SUPPRESS, no cast error
note: createIf(createIf(Tag)) with Tag false, 0 in context Orders. The inner createIf gives SUPPRESS, SUPPRESS; the outer one keeps a SUPPRESS slot SUPPRESS without casting it, so no All and the root is written empty. Casting SUPPRESS would raise po:CREATEIF at C2.
